title: Ethical Hacker Squad findings artifact
description: The machine-readable half of a deliverable. The markdown report is what a person reads; this is what a pipeline can check, diff between engagements and score. Enumerations are NOT repeated here: status, severity, confidence and verification are validated against the declared regions of references/vocabulary.md, which is their single home.

scope.description: The exact path, repository or authorized target the squad was pointed at.

commit.description: Commit or version of the target, when it has one.

language.description: The language the findings are written in. Identifiers are never translated.

generated_by.description: The skill and version that produced this file.

coverage_declaration.description: What was exercised and what was not, in the words of references/traceability.md.

authorization.description: Reference to the authorization under which remote or active tests were run, when any were.

procedure.description: The pack procedure that produced it, or `ad-hoc` when none applies.

status.description: From vocabulary.md. `candidate` may never appear in a deliverable.

severity.description: From vocabulary.md, judged in this system rather than copied from a tool.

evidence.description: The minimal trace or reproduction, already redacted. Placeholders only: [REDACTED:secret], [REDACTED:pii], [REDACTED:internal-host], [REDACTED:payload].

verification.description: From vocabulary.md, when a fix was verified.

inference.description: Required for `probable`: the one link that was inferred rather than observed.

withdrawn_reason.description: Required for `withdrawn`: why a claim already made did not survive.

reason.description: Required whenever the answer is not DOES_NOT_HOLD: the artifact that supports it.

what_would_settle_it.description: Required for `probable`: the artifact, file or symbol that would turn the inference into an observation. A gap named without a way to close it sends the reader nowhere.

ruled_out.description: What was tested and did not appear, and what actively resisted. The section a client almost never receives.

outcome.description: From the verification vocabulary: refuted, inconclusive, not executed or blocked.

where.description: What was exercised and how far it reached. A bound, not a claim about the whole system.
